claims.statement: Over C, for every independent invertible identification of the thirteen target first spaces in 10 Full(5,3)+Full(5,2)+2 P_(5,4,2), the second-leg degree-one Koszul rank is at least 2616. The canonical source 10 Full(5,4) has rank 2595 and cannot degenerate to any such target.
claims.scope: One common canonical first coefficient basis in the source; arbitrary independent target first GL5 identifications and arbitrary complex degeneration maps on every leg, including singular or polar first maps.
claims.limitations: No claim for independently changed source first identifications or for every mixed-orientation target profile. No tensor construction, independent mathematical review, formalization or exponent improvement.
